## Functions

Start with Z-scores

```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

## Turn into function
```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)

  return(z)
  
}
```

Does it work?
```{r, eval = FALSE}
z_scores(x_vec)

z_scores(rpois(40, lambda = 12))

```

## Mean and sd

```{r}
mean_and_sd = function(x) {
  
  return_df = 
    tibble(
      mean = mean(x), 
      sd = sd(x)
    )
  
  return(return_df)

}

mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```

```{r}
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```


## Another function

```{r}
sim_df =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 3)
  )

sim_df |> 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```

```{r}
source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")
```

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 40, mu = 12, sigma = 3)

sim_mean_sd(50, 12, 3)

```
